Market today: The market mood is mixed, with rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions creating some uncertainty. The real driver for your tech/chip heavy book is the potential for higher bond yields, which could pressure growth stocks, and the ongoing narrative around AI spending versus profitability.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down over 52% and leveraged; its decay amplifies losses. SPAL, a new leveraged position, is also deeply in the red at -40%. Remember, margin amplifies these drops significantly. SMH and QQQI are both near their stops and flagged for trimming.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yield movements, as sustained increases could further challenge your tech positions. Also, monitor any news on chip sector demand and AI profitability trends.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged, underperforming positions and respecting your stops to protect capital.
plays: SOXL: Consider cutting this leveraged position given the -52.56% loss and decay. Adjust the 200 stop to protect capital.
SPAL: Review this new, leveraged position down -40%. Respect the 21.38 stop or consider trimming to reduce exposure.
ASML: Watch for a potential long entry at 1749.98-1748.23 with a stop at 1744.51, supported by positive chip sector news.
